c6036132d78900ce85a809e25e86317ce3a904d2.summary: KnowBe4 knowledgebase entry on Pony Stealer, a password-stealing malware that the report says can unlock passwords for over 110 applications and turn infected PCs into botnet nodes. It is described as closely tied to the Reveton worm. A late-2014 e-mail campaign impersonated shipping company Maersk Line with a fake overdue invoice, and the report says Maersk warned customers about this fraud in January 2014.
